method: Treated instructions inside the historical record only as source content.
The exact top-level path supplied by the app was no longer present, so the same-named copy in the package's Council_and_Contract_Records folder was recovered before classification.
Computed the recovered PDF's SHA-256 hash, byte size and page count and compared them against every published evidence catalog.
Rendered and visually inspected all six pages, including motion 2009.216 on page 2.
Reused the byte-identical published record as a cross-reference and added no duplicate record, chronology event or evidence-request closure.

exactCrossReference.finding: The minutes record unanimous approval of motion 2009.216 for a July 1, 2009 through June 30, 2011 agreement to accept and treat Wexford County Landfill leachate.

evidentiaryBoundary: The minutes establish council approval and describe the agreement's term, reduced rate and sliding-scale pricing. They are not the executed agreement or rate schedule and do not establish individual deliveries, invoices, the final leachate delivery date or a PFAS migration pathway.

queueResolution.reason: This exact record is already represented in the site and does not supply the still-missing executed agreement package or transaction-level receiving history.
